data.name: Bhavan
data.long_meaning: Bhavan refers to the cosmic entity, the universe itself, and the inner self. It is derived from the Sanskrit root ‘bhava’, meaning ‘to be’ or ‘to exist’. In Hindu mythology, Bhavan is also the name of the divine abode of Lord Vishnu, where souls go after death and attain liberation from the cycle of birth and death.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to connect with the divine cosmos and seek inner peace and self-realization.
